title: AutoSpecNER: A Fine-Grained Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Vehicle Specification Extraction
description:
AutoSpecNER is an expert-annotated dataset for fine-grained named entity recognition (NER) in vehicle advertisements. It contains 659 car listings from a popular car-selling website, annotated with 4,609 entity spans across 15 vehicle-specification types: MAKE, MODEL, TRIM, YEAR, BODY_TYPE, ENGINE_SPEC, FUEL_TYPE, TRANSMISSION, EXTERIOR_COLOUR, INTERIOR_COLOUR, NO_SEATS, BOOT_SIZE, BATTERY_CAPACITY, BATTERY_RANGE and RECHARGE_TIME.

Contents:

  • vehicle_ner/: the main dataset (659 documents). Each document is given as character-offset entity spans (the canonical annotation), word-level IOB2 tokens and labels, and a companion character-level IOB2 file.
  • iaa_study/: an inter-annotator agreement study in which three anonymised annotators independently labelled the same 100 documents.
  • AutoID_Annotation_Guidelines.pdf: the annotation guidelines.

All data files are UTF-8 JSON Lines; the README documents the schema and label distribution. The dataset accompanies the paper AutoSpecNER: A Fine-Grained Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Vehicle Specification Extraction, published in the Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP-2026), pages 67–81 (preprint: arXiv:2606.24387).
